battle.name: 唐滅劉黑闥之戰
battle.brief: 武德五年（622）正月，劉黑闥在相州稱漢東王，建元天造，定都洺州；李世民與之對峙於洺水，決堰放水淹軍，黑闥奔突厥。次年引突厥兵再攻河北，斬李道玄於下博；建成、元吉進軍昌樂，釋俘誘降破敵，黑闥敗走館陶，饒州被擒、斬於洺州。卡面羅馬標槍此戰未見，消耗重盾前排的用處由弩箭與槊陣承擔。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰雙方是唐高祖李淵新建的唐朝朝廷，與隋末河北起義殘部演成的割據勢力劉黑闥。唐方由尚書省與河北道行軍總管系統調度兵資：武德五年（622）由秦王李世民率河北道行軍大軍討伐，幽州總管羅藝、淮安王李神通部為策應；武德六年（623）改由太子李建成與齊王李元吉領兵，兵源是關中宿衛禁軍、秦王府精騎以及河北諸州郡的團練鄉兵，黑闥平後其眾多復舊職編入官軍。劉黑闥一方以竇建德河北義軍的舊部為骨幹，核心是河北鄉里的農民武裝與游騎，同時向東突厥求援；其武德五年正月進至相州，稱漢東王，建元天造，以范願為左僕射、董康買為兵部尚書、高雅賢為右領軍，竇建德舊日文武悉復舊位，定都洺州，半年之間恢復竇建德故地，河北諸州多歸響應。兩相比較，唐朝握有國家財賦、關中兵源與朝廷名分，劉黑闥則有鄉里人情、舊部名籍與突厥騎兵，唯其財賦不濟、外援須厚賂，久戰不能持。
countriesEn: The two sides were the newly founded court of the Tang founder Li Yuan on one hand and, on the other, the separatist force of Liu Heita, which had grown out of the surviving bands of the late Sui rising in Hebei. The Tang side worked through the Department of State Affairs and the command system of the Hebei Circuit: in the fifth year of Wude, 622, the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, led the field army of the Hebei Circuit in the campaign, with the Prince of Huai'an, Li Shentong, and the Commissioner of Youzhou, Luo Yi, cooperating on the flanks; in the sixth year of Wude, 623, the command passed to the Crown Prince Li Jiancheng and the Prince of Qi, Li Yuanji. The manpower came from the guards and the garrison of the capital region, from the picked cavalry of the Prince of Qin's own household, and from the militia and village levies of the prefectures and counties of Hebei; after Liu's defeat many of his followers were restored to office and enrolled in the imperial army. Liu Heita's side was built on the veterans of Dou Jiande's Hebei army: in the main the armed peasants and riders of the Hebei countryside, reinforced by an appeal to the Eastern Turks. In the first month of the fifth year of Wude he reached Xiangzhou, proclaimed himself King of Handong, set up the reign title of Tianzao, appointed Fan Yuan as left deputy chancellor, Dong Kangmai as minister of war and Gao Yaxian as right commander of the guards, restored Dou Jiande's former officers to their former posts, and made Mingzhou his capital. Within half a year he had recovered Dou Jiande's old territory, and many prefectures of Hebei answered his call. Compared with one another, the Tang had the tax revenue of the state, the soldiers of the capital region and the legitimacy of the court, while Liu had the loyalties of his own countryside, the muster rolls of the old troops and the Turkic horsemen; what he lacked were stable revenue and reliable foreign aid, which had to be bought with heavy tribute, and he could not sustain a long war.
people: 劉黑闥是此役的主角，清河漳南人，少與竇建德為友；隋末從郝孝德參瓦崗軍，武德元年（618）瓦崗敗後為王世充所俘，以騎將守新鄉，不久率部逃回河北，從竇建德封漢東郡公，以驍勇多謀稱於河北。竇建德兵敗被斬於長安，他歸鄉種菜自給，舊將范願、董康買、曹湛、高雅賢等又痛又憤，眾推他為王。武德五年正月他進至相州稱漢東王，隨即定都洺州；被唐軍逼走突厥後，又數引突厥貴族兵力攻掠河北，斬唐河北道行軍大總管、淮陽王李道玄於下博，迫洺州總管廬江王李瑗棄城逃亡。相州內應之役中，洺水人羅士信奉命入城據守，城破戰死。武德六年（623）李建成、李元吉大軍進至昌樂，採太子洗馬魏徵之計釋放俘虜誘降，敵軍內叛，黑闥兵敗，率數百騎夜走館陶；騎將劉弘基緊追，至饒州饒陽，從者僅百餘人，饒州總管崔元遜佯迎入城，借檢閱兵眾之際，令車騎諸葛德威率健卒生擒黑闥，舉城降唐。劉黑闥與弟劉十善等被斬於洺州，首級傳長安，臨刑自言：「我當初有幸逃生在家鋤菜，為高雅賢輩所誤至此。」
peopleEn: Liu Heita is the central figure of this campaign. He was a native of Zhangnan in Qinghe, and was a friend of Dou Jiande from boyhood. At the end of the Sui he joined the Wagang army under Hao Xiaode; in the first year of Wude, 618, after the Wagang host was destroyed, he was taken prisoner by Wang Shichong, who employed him as a commander of horse to guard Xinxiang, and he soon led his men away and returned to Hebei, where he followed Dou Jiande and was enfeoffed as Duke of Handong, and he was known throughout Hebei for his courage and for his resourcefulness. After Dou Jiande was defeated and beheaded at Chang'an, Liu went home to his village and grew vegetables to feed himself, and the old commanders of Dou, among them Fan Yuan, Dong Kangmai, Cao Zhan and Gao Yaxian, were grieved and indignant at once, so they raised Liu Heita as their king. In the first month of the fifth year of Wude he reached Xiangzhou, called himself King of Handong, and soon fixed his capital at Mingzhou. In the business of taking a city by an internal hand, a man from Mingshui county offered to act as a guide, the commandery commander Luo Shixin was sent into the city to hold it, and when Liu took the city back the young Luo died in the fight. After Liu had been driven off to the Turks he led their nobles' troops into Hebei again and again, and he killed the Prince of Huaiyang, Li Daoxuan, the commander-in-chief of the march on Hebei, at Xiabo, and forced the Prince of Lujiang, the governor of Mingzhou, to abandon his city. The turning point of the sixth year of Wude, 623, came when Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji advanced in full force as far as Changle; on the counsel of Wei Zheng, who served the Crown Prince as a palace attendant, the prisoners were released so as to spread word of the kindness of the Tang, and men of Liu's own army deserted before the battle was joined. Liu was defeated, rode off at night with several hundred horsemen towards Guantao, and the cavalry commander Liu Hongji pursued him closely; at Raozhou, in Raoyang, only a little over a hundred men were left with him. The governor of Raozhou, Cui Yuanxun, came out to welcome him and led him towards the city, and while pretending to let him inspect the picked troops within, he closed in, and the cavalry officer Zhuge Dewei with a band of healthy soldiers seized the black king alive and the city surrendered to the Tang. Liu Heita and his brother Liu Shishan and others were beheaded at Mingzhou, and his head was carried to Chang'an; at the place of execution he said that he had once escaped in safety to hoe his vegetables at home, and that he had come to this pass through the counsel of men such as Gao Yaxian.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是羅馬標槍，羅馬共和末期至帝國早期帝國步兵軍團的制式重投槍：槍身中空，鐵製的頸與前段約半米長，後接木桿，擲出後命中盾牌即折斷，敵兵只能握著半截槍退回掩體，設計意圖不是貫穿殺傷，而是遠程消耗敵方密集重盾的前排。必須說明的是，羅馬標槍並不會出現在六二二年的河北戰場：唐軍的裝備體系是步槊、馬槊、長矛標槍、蹶張弩與臂弩、角弓與長弓、傍牌大盾、兜鍪鍔甲與明光甲、橫刀與佩刀，攻城則用投石機、撞車、雲梯與撞竿破門，營前列拒馬、鹿角與羓藁。功能上，標槍打散前排重盾的任務在唐軍由弩箭齊射與密集槊陣承擔，與羅馬軍團三段投擲齊射壓制盾陣的原理相通，只是器械不同：弩能重複射擊，槊能在盾後近身纏鬥，兩者都是消耗敵方陣線而非先取人性命。追擊與奔馳階段雙方都靠馬匹與刀槊，跟羅馬騎兵用短劍追砍同理，投槍只在交戰第一線有用。糧秣靠河北郡縣徵發與車運，劉黑闥最後靠數百騎夜走館陶，馬匹數量直接決定他能逃多遠。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman pilum, the standard heavy javelin of the Roman imperial infantry in the late Republic and the early Empire. Its shaft is hollow, the iron collar and the forward section run about half a metre, and a wooden shaft is fitted behind it; once thrown, the javelin breaks on striking a shield, so that the man who threw it can only drag himself back to cover gripping half a weapon. The design was not aimed at penetration and killing but at long range harassment of the enemy's dense line of heavy shields. It has to be said plainly that the Roman pilum did not appear on the field in Hebei in the year 622. The equipment system of the Tang army consisted of the foot spear, the mounted spear, the long thrusting pike, the waist-drawn crossbow and the braced crossbow, the horn bow and the long bow, the large wicker-faced shield, the helmet and the armour of bright metal, and the sword worn at the waist; for sieges they used the stone-thrower, the ram, the scaling ladder and the battering pole against the gates, and they planted tripods, caltrops and thorn faggots in front of the camp. In functional terms the task of the pilum, of breaking up the enemy's front rank of heavy shields, was carried in the Tang army by volleys of crossbow bolts and by the massed ranks of spears; the principle was the same as the three-stage volley of pila thrown by a Roman cohort to crush a shield line, only the weapon was different, for the crossbow could fire repeatedly and the spear could fight at close quarters behind the shield, and both worked on the enemy's order of battle rather than on his casualties. In the pursuit and in the flight the fighting on both sides rested on horses and on the sword and the spear, just as the Roman horseman finished his charge with the short sword: the thrown javelin was of use only on the first line of contact. As for supply, the grain was drawn from the prefectures and counties of Hebei and moved by cart, and the last flight of Liu Heita, several hundred horsemen riding through the night towards Guantao, showed that the number of horses in hand decided how far he could get away.
tactics: 此役的戰術主軸是隔水相持、以工程決戰與心理戰破敵。武德五年李世民與劉黑闥在洺水對峙，唐軍不急於強攻，先在河道上游築堰蓄水，待漢東軍背水列陣之際決堰放水，淹其營而逼其北走；同一條戰線上，洺水縣人曾請為內應，遣羅士信入城據守，黑闥反攻城、羅士信戰死，唐軍則退回水北整頓。劉黑闥奔突厥後再引其騎兵入河北，靠的是零星襲擾與重奪城池，河北道行軍大總管李道玄戰死於下博，洺州總管李瑗棄城，唐軍一度退守，武德六年李建成、李元吉以全力進攻，兩軍相峙於昌樂。破局之計是魏徵所獻的釋俘誘降：把俘獲的河北舊卒縱回，令其傳話唐軍厚待，自有軍中倒戈，敵陣未接戰已先亂；唐軍乘其內叛掩擊，黑闥僅以數百騎夜走館陶，劉弘基率騎兵緊追，追至饒州只剩百餘人。最後一環是城下的詐降：崔元遜出迎、設食、請其檢閱城中精兵，名為款待，實則召兵合圍，由諸葛德威生擒。一場戰爭由堰壩、夜襲、縱俘、騎兵追擊到城下設伏，五種手段疊在一起，才把河北最後的割據收拾乾淨。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of the campaign was the standoff across a river, fought out with engineering works and with the war of nerves. In the fifth year of Wude Li Shimin and Liu Heita faced one another at Mingshui, and the Tang army did not press the attack; it first raised a weir on the upper course of the stream to hold back the water, and when the army of the King of Handong had drawn up with the river at its back it broke the weir and let the water down, drowning the camp and driving the enemy north. On the same line, the people of Mingshui county had offered to act as an internal guide and Luo Shixin was sent into the city to hold it, but Liu took the city back and Luo died in the fighting, while the Tang fell back north of the stream to regroup. After his flight to the Turks, Liu brought their horsemen into Hebei again and again, relying on raids and on the retaking of cities; the commander-in-chief of the march on Hebei, Li Daoxuan, was killed at Xiabo and the governor of Mingzhou abandoned his city, so that the Tang once more fell back on the defensive. In the sixth year of Wude Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji advanced in full force and the two armies stood opposed at Changle. The stroke that broke the deadlock was the counsel of Wei Zheng to release the prisoners and let word spread of how well the Tang treated those who came in, so that men of the enemy army deserted before the battle was joined; the Tang struck into the disorder, and Liu rode off with several hundred horsemen through the night towards Guantao, with Liu Hongji's cavalry in close pursuit, until at Raozhou only a little over a hundred men remained with him. The last piece was a deception at the foot of the city: Cui Yuanxun came out to meet him, set out food, and asked to show him the picked troops within, in appearance a courtesy, in fact a closing of the net, and Zhuge Dewei took him alive. It took five devices laid one upon another, the weir, the night attack, the releasing of the prisoners, the cavalry pursuit and the ambush at the city, to finish off the last separatism in Hebei.
data: 現存史冊對此役的記載以敘事為主，具體數字不多，只能取其約數。時間上，劉黑闥於武德五年正月（622）進至相州稱王建元，同年冬季在洺水決堰之敗中北走，武德六年（623）引突厥兵再入河北，武德六年正月初五被擒於饒州並誅於洺州，自稱王到授首約一年有餘；而從竇建德被斬於長安算起，河北義軍的殘餘掙扎橫跨兩年。兵力上，唐軍與劉黑闥軍的總數均不見明文，只可從幾處記載推知規模：饒州總管崔元遜麾下有軍隊三千餘，劉黑闥敗走館陶時隨行數百騎，到饒州時從者僅百餘人，生擒他的健卒人數亦不詳，昌樂之戰李建成、李元吉的投入史稱以全力進攻。距離上，以直線估算：洺水（曲周西北）距洺州城（永年廣府）四十餘里，洺州至昌樂（南樂）約三百餘里，館陶至饒陽約三百五十里，下博在饒陽西南數十里。城防與器械方面，洺州為劉黑闥自建的都城，牆垣與城防器械是其立國根本。損失方面，史料只言降眾歸附、舊將復官，沒有可靠的傷亡與俘獲總數。
dataEn: The surviving records of this campaign are narrative in character and the exact figures are few, so only approximations can be taken. In time, Liu Heita reached Xiangzhou and proclaimed himself king with the reign title Tianzao in the first month of the fifth year of Wude, 622; in the winter of the same year he was defeated at Mingshui when the weir was broken and he fled north; in the sixth year of Wude, 623, he brought Turkic troops into Hebei once more, and on the fifth day of the first month he was taken at Raozhou and executed at Mingzhou, so that from the proclamation of his kingship to his death a little over a year passed; counted from the beheading of Dou Jiande at Chang'an, the last struggles of the Hebei rebels ran across two years. In strength, no clear figures for the total on either side survive, and the scale can only be inferred from a few passages: the governor of Raozhou, Cui Yuanxun, had a force of more than three thousand men; Liu Heita rode off towards Guantao with several hundred horsemen, and when he reached Raozhou only a little over a hundred were still with him, the number of the healthy soldiers who seized him is not given, and the commitment of Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji at Changle is described in the histories as an attack made with all their strength. In distance, reckoned in a straight line: Mingshui, to the north-west of Quzhou, lies a little over forty li from the city of Mingzhou at Yongnian; Mingzhou is about three hundred li from Changle at Nanle; Guantao is about three hundred and fifty li from Raoyang; and Xiabo lies a few dozen li south-west of Raoyang. As for the defences, Mingzhou was a capital that Liu Heita had raised himself, and its walls and its siege equipment were the foundation of his state. As for losses, the histories only say that the men who came over were re-enrolled and the old commanders restored to office, and give no reliable totals of casualties or prisoners.
cause: 起兵的緣由有三層。最直接的一層是竇建德的敗亡：武德四年（621）五月竇建德在虎牢關被李世民擒獲，同年七月被斬首於長安，消息傳到河北，舊將范願、董康買、曹湛、高雅賢等既痛又憤，嘆道「若不起兵報仇，實亦恥見天下人物」，於是共推劉黑闥為王。第二層是唐廷在河北的治理惡劣：唐軍派往河北的官吏徵發暴虐，河北自隋末以來屢遭兵禍的鄉里既缺糧又缺丁，最願借劉黑闥之力護住自己的城池土地，於是響應者眾；竇建德舊部仍保有完整的部曲名籍與鄉里關係，一呼而河北諸州響應，半年之間便恢復其故地。第三層是外部條件：劉黑闥遣使北結東突厥，藉突厥騎兵壯聲勢、擾唐軍後方，而唐廷北方正需兵備患，一旦河北牽制住唐軍，關中與河南的部署便無從兼顧。李世民與魏徵的應對，也正是圍著這三層展開：先以決堰破其主力，再以釋俘破其人心。
causeEn: There are three layers to the reason the war began. The most immediate is the fall of Dou Jiande. In the fifth month of the fourth year of Wude, 621, Dou Jiande was taken prisoner by Li Shimin at the Pass of Hulao, and in the seventh month of the same year he was beheaded at Chang'an; when the news reached Hebei, the old commanders of Dou, among them Fan Yuan, Dong Kangmai, Cao Zhan and Gao Yaxian, were grieved and indignant at once, and they sighed that if they did not rise to avenge him, they would be ashamed to show themselves before the men of the age; so they raised Liu Heita as their king together. The second layer is the harshness of the Tang administration in Hebei. The officials the Tang sent into Hebei were oppressive in their levies, and the countryside of Hebei, which had suffered through war since the end of the Sui, was short of grain and of labour, and it was only too ready to use Liu Heita to shield its own towns and fields, which is why so many answered him; Dou Jiande's old troops still held complete muster rolls and ties of kinship in the villages, and at a single call the prefectures of Hebei answered, so that within half a year he had recovered the old territory. The third layer is external. Liu Heita sent envoys north to the Eastern Turks, to borrow their horsemen to make his cause look strong and to harry the Tang rear, while the Tang court had need of every soldier to guard the north; once Hebei held the Tang army there, the deployment of the capital region and of Henan could not be looked to at the same time. The answers of Li Shimin and of Wei Zheng were framed in exactly these three terms: first to break the main rebel host by breaking the weir, and then to break the heart of the enemy by releasing the prisoners.
impact: 此役的結果改變了唐初的戰略地圖。劉黑闥是隋末河北最後一支成建制的割據武力，他的覆亡使河北諸州重新回到朝廷的版籍與賦稅之內，戶口與流亡百姓得以復業，河北大族與地方武裝的觀望也被壓下去；唐由此完成關中、河南、河北一體的北方整合，得以抽出手來對付北方的東突厥與東北的高句麗，貞觀年間的西域經營與幾次征高句麗，其後盾正是這場平亂。此役還把河北的兵員直接併入唐軍：黑闥部眾降唐後多復舊官，河北熟習騎射與水土的鄉兵成了唐軍北征的骨幹之一，唐軍在幽州、雲州方向的部署因此更為順手。人物上，魏徵在昌樂之役獻計破敵，展露了謀略與膽識，日後為唐太宗的重要宰相；劉弘基以追擊之功入凌煙閣；羅士信年未及弱冠戰歿於洺水，被追贈。兵器史上，這一役也說明中原的消耗性投射兵器並不靠外來的重投槍維持，而靠弩與槊與弓的組合，羅馬標槍所代表的以廉價投射物拆散敵人前排的做法，在唐軍的弩陣與槊陣裡有功能上的對應。
impactEn: The outcome of this campaign changed the strategic map of the early Tang. Liu Heita was the last organized separatist force in Hebei at the end of the Sui, and his extinction returned the prefectures of Hebei to the registers and to the taxation of the court, allowed the registers of households and the refugees to be restored to their fields, and put down the waiting and watching of the great families of Hebei and of the local armed men. The Tang thus completed the integration of the north, of the capital region, of Henan and of Hebei into one, and could draw its hands free to face the Eastern Turks on the northern frontier and Goguryeo in the northeast; the conduct of affairs in the Western Regions and the campaigns against Goguryeo in the Zhenguan years had this pacification of the north for their support. The campaign also folded the soldiers of Hebei straight into the Tang army: after Liu's defeat many of his men were restored to office, and the Hebei villagers, practised with the bow and the horse and familiar with the ground, became one of the main sources of troops for the northern marches, so that the deployment of the Tang on the Youzhou and Yunzhou fronts ran more smoothly. As for the men themselves, Wei Zheng showed at Changle both the cunning and the courage that marked him, and he was later a leading minister of Tang Taizong; Liu Hongji entered the Lingyan Pavilion on the strength of his pursuit; and Luo Shixin fell at Mingshui before he was twenty, and was posthumously honoured. In the history of arms the campaign also showed that the consumable missile weapons of the Central Plain were not sustained by an imported heavy javelin but by the combination of crossbow, spear and bow, and that the Roman pilum's idea of breaking up the enemy's front rank with cheap missiles has its functional counterpart in the crossbow ranks and the spear ranks of the Tang.
result: 戰爭以劉黑闥一方的徹底覆滅收場。武德五年（622）洺水一役，唐軍決堰放水，漢東軍大潰，黑闥與范願等北走突厥；同年冬季他引突厥貴族兵力再度攻入河北，先斬李道玄於下博，又迫李瑗棄洺州，聲勢一度復熾，河北諸州再度響應。轉折出在武德六年（623）正月：建成、元吉大軍進至昌樂，採魏徵釋俘誘降之計，河北舊卒在陣中倒戈，黑闥兵敗，率數百騎夜走館陶，劉弘基率騎兵緊追不放，追到饒州時只剩百餘隨從；饒州總管崔元遜以詐降之禮相迎，名為款待、請其檢閱城中精兵，實則合圍，車騎諸葛德威率健卒生擒，黑闥罵「狗輩負我」，隨即解送，與弟劉十善等一併斬於洺州，首級傳送長安。河北其後平定無亂，降眾多復舊職，州縣建置重新歸於朝廷，此役成為唐初北方統一的最後一役。
resultEn: The war closed with the complete destruction of Liu Heita's side. In the campaign at Mingshui in the fifth year of Wude, 622, the Tang broke the weir and let the water down, the army of the King of Handong was destroyed and Liu fled north to the Turks with Fan Yuan and others. In the winter of that year he brought the troops of Turkic nobles into Hebei once more, killed Li Daoxuan at Xiabo and forced the Prince of Lujiang to abandon Mingzhou, so that his strength flared up again and the prefectures of Hebei answered him a second time. The turn came in the first month of the sixth year of Wude, 623. The army of Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji reached Changle, and the plan of releasing the prisoners to induce desertion, counseled by Wei Zheng, turned soldiers of the Hebei army against their own side before the battle was joined. Liu was defeated and rode off through the night with several hundred horsemen towards Guantao, with Liu Hongji's cavalry in close pursuit, until at Raozhou a little over a hundred followers were all that remained. Cui Yuanxun, the governor of Raozhou, met him with the courtesies of a surrender, in appearance a welcome and an inspection of the picked troops of the city, in fact a closing of the net, and Zhuge Dewei with healthy soldiers took him alive; Liu cursed them as dog-broken creatures who had betrayed him, and was sent off to be beheaded at Mingzhou with his brother Liu Shishan and others, his head being carried to Chang'an. Hebei was thereafter settled and quiet, many of the men who came over were restored to their old posts, and the prefectures and counties returned to the arrangements of the court; the campaign was the last of the campaigns that completed the unification of the north in the early Tang.
